enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +28: Passive: +28 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Static Attraction: This weapon attracts the static electricity in the air, and over time will charge with magic while held in your main hand. Every five seconds, this weapon gains a charge of Static Electricity, up to a maxiumum of 3, providing a +10 Exceptional bonus to Electric Spell Power and a +5% Exceptional bonus to Electric Spell Lore. When you cast an Electric spell, all stacks are consumed.
Lightning Lore +21: Passive: Your Electricity spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Magnetism +145: Passive: +145 Equipment bonus to Electricity Spell Power.
Evocation Focus +7: +7 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
